property_summary: For any actor and amount, a successful deposit followed by withdrawAll pays out exactly once: repeated withdrawAll calls must be no-ops afterwards, so the actor's total payout equals the deposited amount; the mutant keeps credit non-zero so a second withdrawAll re-pays (and reverts on underflow), violating this.
change_summary: Delete the statement resetting the caller's credit to zero, so credit persists after withdrawal.
